notes.content: The continued sentence is followed by Axiomes, discussing possible underlying sets for an axiomatization of ateliers: the family F, M or L. It contrasts simplicity of the data with transparency of the essential axioms and asks whether the case of M may be similar. Display (1.16) gives three proposed structures on F. A dated objection points to choice b). Choice c) includes a map to P(F), a deployment notation, and an incidence gloss attached below et and the map. A canceled right-hand gloss retains a locally canceled noun and raised replacement. The closing paragraph announces a diagram of six fundamental relations, then defines incidence in (1.17); the diagram itself is not drawn on this page.
math_reading_decisions: The dated note literally denies that b) still implies ll under the author’s new viewpoint. The objection is transcribed, not mathematically proved.
The underbrace begins below et and spans the map. Its placement does not include the earlier ll. The map arrow is rightward; the element notation has a mapsto bar and tilde.

Plain upright P is locally clear. The family F and cursive M keep explicit first-occurrence alphabet doubts. The first F operand in (1.17) has a retraced/doubled upper stem, retained as ordinary F versus blackboard F.

The closed left-pointing incidence triangle and defining equivalence are preserved. Clear dfn remains above, and uncertain par below. The two written incidence conjunctions agree in their content, but this text comparison is not a proof check.
Literal singular le plus transparent is preserved. The word endings and date separator remain uncertain where the ink does not decide them.
author_doubts: “(ou peut-être pareil pour M ?)” asks whether the same comparison holds for M.
The dated note reads “Non, par mon nouveau point de vue ça n'implique plus ≪”; its date separator remains hyphen/point.
No additional à vérifier or sauf erreur request is present on this page.
notes.titles_dates_counts: Manuscript page 10; underlined Axiomes and Sur F. Date 20-juin / 20. juin, with no written year. Two display labels, (1.16) and (1.17); choices a), b), c); six fundamental relations are announced. No separate diagram, drawing, archive pencil number, footer or typed text is reported by the readers.
